title: Base shape
spec: Start by creating a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Next, draw a two-dimensional sketch on the first face. Begin with the first loop, which consists of thirteen lines. Start by drawing the first line from the origin (0.0, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0). Continue with the second line from (0.75, 0.0) to (0.75, 0.0687), followed by the third line from (0.75, 0.0687) to (0.4973, 0.1209). The fourth line runs from (0.4973, 0.1209) to (0.4973, 0.0687), and the fifth line goes from (0.4973, 0.0687) to (0.3599, 0.0687). The sixth line extends from (0.3599, 0.0687) to (0.3077, 0.1566), and the seventh line moves from (0.3077, 0.1566) to (0.1704, 0.1566). The eighth line is drawn from (0.1704, 0.1566) to (0.088, 0.0934), and the ninth line connects (0.088, 0.0934) to (0.0395, 0.1566). The tenth line runs from (0.0395, 0.1566) to (0.088, 0.2308), and the eleventh line continues from (0.088, 0.2308) to (0.088, 0.3). The twelfth line goes from (0.088, 0.3) to (0.0, 0.3), and the thirteenth line completes the loop by connecting (0.0, 0.3) back to the origin at (0.0, 0.0). After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled sketch into three-dimensional space by rotating it with Euler angles set to zero and translating it with a vector also set to zero. Finally, extrude the sketch 0.03 units in the direction of the normal to create a new solid body. The resulting base shape is a complex three-dimensional model with a main body and a protruding section on one side, measuring 0.75 units in length, 0.3 units in width, and 0.03 units in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
wp = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch
sketch = wp.polyline([
    (0.0, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.0),
    (0.75, 0.0687),
    (0.4973, 0.1209),
    (0.4973, 0.0687),
    (0.3599, 0.0687),
    (0.3077, 0.1566),
    (0.1704, 0.1566),
    (0.088, 0.0934),
    (0.0395, 0.1566),
    (0.088, 0.2308),
    (0.088, 0.3),
    (0.0, 0.3),
    (0.0, 0.0)
]).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extruded = sketch.extrude(0.03)

# Assign the final model to 'r'
r = extruded

# Display the model

import cadquery as cq

# Plate outline in the XY plane (matches TOP view), thickness in Z
outline = [
    (0.0, 0.0),        # bottom-left
    (0.75, 0.0),       # bottom-right
    (0.75, 0.067),     # right end (low)
    (0.497, 0.122),    # slope up-left to step
    (0.497, 0.067),    # step down
    (0.362, 0.067),    # flat low section
    (0.312, 0.158),    # slope up to middle bump (right side)
    (0.185, 0.158),    # middle bump top
    (0.160, 0.090),    # notch inner (right)
    (0.042, 0.163),    # notch V tip (left)
    (0.093, 0.245),    # up-right back to left block
    (0.093, 0.300),    # left block right edge top
    (0.0, 0.300),      # top-left
]

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(outline[0][0], outline[0][1])
    .lineTo(*outline[1])
    .lineTo(*outline[2])
    .lineTo(*outline[3])
    .lineTo(*outline[4])
    .lineTo(*outline[5])
    .lineTo(*outline[6])
    .lineTo(*outline[7])
    .lineTo(*outline[8])
    .lineTo(*outline[9])
    .lineTo(*outline[10])
    .lineTo(*outline[11])
    .lineTo(*outline[12])
    .close()
    .extrude(0.03)
)
